definitions.gloss: binge eating and drinking; overeating and overdrinking
definitions.explanation: the act of consuming excessive amounts of food and alcohol in an uncontrolled manner

{暴飲暴食|ぼういんぼうしょく} is a four-character compound: {暴|ぼう} (violent/excessive) + {飲|いん} (drink) + {暴|ぼう} (violent/excessive) + {食|しょく} (eat).

USAGE:
Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb. Often associated with stress, holidays, or lack of self-control.
